$comment: The raw downloads of data/SOURCES.md ('Raw downloads') and how to get each back. Used by Tools/data/refetch_raw.py; bytes and sha256 are filled in by its --record. Paths are under the raw folder (Tools/rawdir.py). Kinds: url, files, ogc-features, pull, command (see the script's docstring).

items.licence: IGN / CNIG, CC BY 4.0 (MDT25 CC-BY 4.0 scne.es)
items.note: 35 tiles of 20 km over ETRS89 UTM 30N x 485000-615000, y 4640000-4735000; the exact tile edges were not recorded [A]
command: for x in 485000 505000 525000 545000 565000 585000 605000; do for y in 4640000 4660000 4680000 4700000 4720000; do curl -sSfL -o "mdt25_${x}_${y}.tif" "https://servicios.idee.es/wcs-inspire/mdt?SERVICE=WCS&VERSION=2.0.1&REQUEST=GetCoverage&COVERAGEID=Elevacion25830_25&FORMAT=image/tiff&SUBSET=x($x,$((x+20000)))&SUBSET=y($y,$((y+20000)))"; done; done

items.note: MDT05 (5 m) over the same box in 10 km tiles; same WCS, coverage Elevacion25830_5
command: for x in $(seq -f %.0f 485000 10000 605000); do for y in $(seq -f %.0f 4640000 10000 4720000); do curl -sSfL -o "mdt05_${x}_${y}.tif" "https://servicios.idee.es/wcs-inspire/mdt?SERVICE=WCS&VERSION=2.0.1&REQUEST=GetCoverage&COVERAGEID=Elevacion25830_5&FORMAT=image/tiff&SUBSET=x($x,$((x+10000)))&SUBSET=y($y,$((y+10000)))"; done; done

items.note: 4 tiles of 200 m DEM, coverage Elevacion25830_200, x -80000-1140000, y 3980000-4870000; the split into 4 tiles is not recorded [A]: here two columns by two rows
command: for x in -80000 530000; do for y in 3980000 4425000; do curl -sSfL -o "mdt200_${x}_${y}.tif" "https://servicios.idee.es/wcs-inspire/mdt?SERVICE=WCS&VERSION=2.0.1&REQUEST=GetCoverage&COVERAGEID=Elevacion25830_200&FORMAT=image/tiff&SUBSET=x($x,$((x+610000)))&SUBSET=y($y,$((y+445000)))"; done; done

items.note: Madeira: CAOP RAM GeoPackage, layer ram_distritos, only Ilha da Madeira and Ilha de Porto Santo (Desertas and Selvagens dropped), simplified to about 40 m (781.7 km2). Field values checked with ogrinfo 22 Oct 2026 [V]
command: cd "${ATLASLOPE_RAW:-$HOME/Developer/Atlaslope-raw}/countries/pt" && curl -sSfL -o CAOP_RAM_2025-gpkg.zip https://geo2.dgterritorio.gov.pt/caop/CAOP_RAM_2025-gpkg.zip && unzip -oq CAOP_RAM_2025-gpkg.zip -d ram
ogr2ogr -f GeoJSON caop2025-ram-islands.geojson ram/*.gpkg ram_distritos -t_srs EPSG:4326 -where "distrito IN ('Ilha da Madeira','Ilha de Porto Santo')" -simplify 0.00036 -makevalid
